scripts.build: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); fs.rmSync('dist', {recursive:true, force:true}); fs.rmSync('frontend/dist', {recursive:true, force:true});" && cd frontend && npm install && npm run build && cd .. && npm run copy-dist
scripts.copy-dist: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); fs.rmSync('dist', {recursive:true, force:true}); fs.cpSync('frontend/dist', 'dist', {recursive:true});"
